title: Don Ebubeogu
content:
Donatus "Don" Ebubeogu  is a Nigerian industrialist, entrepreneur, and agribusiness advocate. He is the co-founder and Managing Director of Tiger Foods Limited, a major Nigerian food processing and manufacturing company based in Onitsha, Anambra State. Ebubeogu served as the 12th President of the Onitsha Chamber of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (ONICCIMA).


== Early life and education ==
Don Ebubeogu was born in Onitsha, Anambra State, Nigeria. He obtained his early education in southeastern Nigeria before pursuing further studies in business and management. Details of his formal academic background are not widely published.


== Career ==
Ebubeogu began his career as a small-scale food vendor before expanding into commercial spice blending and packaged food production. In 1997, alongside his brother Celestine Ebubeogu, he co-founded Tiger Foods Limited. The company produces food condiments, seasonings, and packaged agricultural products, including curry powder, thyme, ginger, dried vegetables, and packaged beans under its Tiger and Vegeta brands.
Under his leadership, Tiger Foods has expanded its processing capacity and partnered with the Nigerian federal and Anambra State governments on agribusiness development and export initiatives.


== Leadership and public service ==
Ebubeogu served as the 12th President of the Onitsha Chamber of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (ONICCIMA). In this capacity, he advocated for improved industrial infrastructure and enabling policies for local manufacturers. He has also been a vocal advocate for addressing logistical challenges faced by businesses in southeastern Nigeria, particularly the poor state of the Onitsha–Owerri road.


== Philanthropy and recognition ==
Ebubeogu’s entrepreneurial journey and community impact were highlighted during the media coverage of his 50th birthday celebration in 2022. In 2023, his brother and business partner, Celestine Ebubeogu, was named "Industrialist of the Year" at The Sun Awards, in recognition of their company’s contributions to Nigeria’s manufacturing sector.


== Personal life ==
Ebubeogu is married and resides in Onitsha, Anambra State, where he manages Tiger Foods Limited.
